fact: In July 2024 the Ministry of Justice said the technology-backed integrated criminal records system (CRIMS) was planned as a pillar of its own in the three-year justice sector transformation roadmap, and the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute presented the gaps of the project the ministry had tried before, the remedies, the time to completion and the budget required.
title: የፍትሕ ሚኒስቴርና የኢትዮጵያ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ኢንስቲትዩት የተቀናጀ የወንጀል መዛግብት ሥርዓት ፕሮጀክት ዙሪያ ዉይይት አደረጉ
